Baked Beets
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, February 10, 2010 - 6:32pm

Ingredients




beets, whole, unpeeled
removed, washed

Preparation

1 Place beets on a tray, in an oven at 350Ffor 1 hour. Let cool slightly and slip off skins, mash and serve with butter and/or sour cream. 2 Squeeze a bit of lime onto them right before serving.
